Bir pod çökerse controller yeni pod oluş: If a Pod fails, a controller can create a replacement. The Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) increases replicas as load rises; the Cluster Autoscaler can request nodes when capacity is insufficient. Response time depends on provider, image and capacity.

Sunucusuz bir iş, bir olay tarafından te: An event triggers serverless work: an HTTP request, queue message, timer or file upload. Choose the right trigger first; available options vary by provider (API Gateway, S3 events, EventBridge, Pub/Sub…).
Her fonksiyonu küçük ve tek bir iş yapac: Keep each function small and focused: convert an image, validate a row or publish a webhook. Large functions quickly become monolithic server code.
Lambda/Cloud Functions stateless’tir. Ka: Lambda/Cloud Functions are stateless. Use an external service such as DynamoDB, Cosmos DB, S3 or Redis for persistent data. A function may run hundreds of times concurrently; the local filesystem is not reliable persistent storage.
Tekrar deneme davranışı tetikleyiciye ve: Retry behavior depends on the trigger and settings; synchronous callers may be responsible for retries. Configure a dead-letter queue or failure destination where supported. Write idempotent functions so repeated events do not duplicate side effects.
Seyrek çağrılan fonksiyonlarda soğuk baş: Cold starts for infrequently called functions can range from tens of milliseconds to seconds depending on runtime, package size, network and provider. Provisioned concurrency may reduce latency but adds cost.

Model eğitimi ve çıkarımı için GPU gücün: Renting the right amount of GPU capacity for the right duration for training and inference.
GPU seçiminin anahtarı VRAM’dir (GPU bel: VRAM is central to GPU selection. FP16/BF16 weights alone require roughly 14 GB for a 7B model and 140 GB for a 70B model; quantization may reduce this. Runtime, KV cache, context length and batching require additional memory.
Eğitim (training) çoğu iş yükünde çıkarı: Training often takes longer and consumes more resources than inference. You need not use the same GPU for both; select hardware separately for model size, precision, latency and throughput targets.
Kontrol noktası alınabilen eğitim işleri: Checkpointable training that tolerates interruption may benefit from spot discounts. Production inference with latency and availability targets may require on-demand or committed capacity. Plan these as separate pipelines.
Eğitim verisi yüzlerce GB olabilir. Veri: Training data may occupy hundreds of GB. Keeping data in the same region as compute may reduce inter-region or internet egress; charges depend on the service path. Cloudflare R2 offers free internet egress, but request and storage fees must also be considered.
GPU saatleri hızlıca yüksek faturalara u: GPU hours can quickly produce large bills. Set budget alerts (for example, 50 USD/day); alerts do not automatically stop spending. Configure separate shutdown automation if needed. Terminate unused instances; forgotten resources are a common cost driver.
Büyük modeli ölçmeden 7/24 çalışır durum: Leaving a large model running 24/7 without measurement. Required replicas and the economics of serverless GPUs depend on traffic, model-loading time, latency targets and scaling limits.
